purpose: Display an inclusive UTC calendar schedule with scale navigation and optional task selection.
behaviorProvider: Native SVG/layout and shared SegmentedControl; local gantt-model validation.

component: Use ganttModel to reject empty/duplicate IDs, invalid calendar dates and end-before-start records, showing their labels in a status notice. Dates are validated as exact YYYY-MM-DD UTC calendar days.
Clamp finite progress to zero through one hundred and use zero for nonfinite/missing progress. A milestone ends on its start date after input dates have passed validation.
Use controlled scale when supplied, otherwise initialize local scale from defaultScale. The segmented control updates local state only uncontrolled and always calls onScaleChange when provided.
host: Own editing, persistence, selectedTaskId and dependency correctness. Supply today explicitly for a deterministic marker; this chart does not schedule, drag-resize, resolve cycles or update the current date.

requirements.statement: Use ganttModel to reject empty/duplicate IDs, invalid calendar dates and end-before-start records, showing their labels in a status notice. Dates are validated as exact YYYY-MM-DD UTC calendar days.
Clamp finite progress to zero through one hundred and use zero for nonfinite/missing progress. A milestone ends on its start date after input dates have passed validation.
Use controlled scale when supplied, otherwise initialize local scale from defaultScale. The segmented control updates local state only uncontrolled and always calls onScaleChange when provided.
Expand week bounds to Monday-based weeks and month bounds to calendar months. Display an explanatory replacement rather than a grid when the padded interval exceeds 366 times five days.
Render bars as named buttons only when onTaskSelect exists; emit the normalized task and derive aria-pressed from selectedTaskId when supplied. Otherwise render noninteractive role=img task bars.
Draw known nonself dependency edges decoratively; include dependencies in task labels and exact schedule data. Unknown dependency IDs remain textual references and do not create paths.
Measure available plot width with ResizeObserver and a debounced update; disconnect the observer and clear its timer on effect cleanup. Keep the timeline as a named focusable scroll region.
Provide a native schedule-data disclosure with task/start/end/progress/owner/dependency headers. Show a today marker only for a valid explicit date inside the model range.

Own editing, persistence, selectedTaskId and dependency correctness. Supply today explicitly for a deterministic marker; this chart does not schedule, drag-resize, resolve cycles or update the current date.
Consume data-viz group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: No critical-path calculation, dependency-cycle validation, work calendars or task editing.
Large row counts are not virtualized even within the bounded calendar span.
